Multi-seat consultation. Public repository facts only. No customer data, no mail bodies, no credentials, no wallet or signer material, no amounts.

TASK: for each of the 19 open items below, every worker seat must answer independently. Judge ONLY whether this item can be automated under that authorization, what blocks it, the risk of automating it, and the first concrete step. Do not execute anything. Do not merge, deploy, call APIs, or claim any state changed.

ITEMS (id :: current verified state)
1 :: Phase1 six safety requirements sit only in PR #398 whose base feat/order-closure is 209 commits behind main; main scripts/hire-phase1.mjs has no ACCEPTANCE_GATE_ALLOWLIST.

ROUTES (choose exactly one per item): automate_now | automate_after_fix | needs_owner_value | needs_external_evidence | keep_manual | needs_rule_decision

RULES IN ORDER
1 Stay inside written limits; repo evidence only; no self-attested provider/model; no scope expansion.
2 Opinions are advisory only; the owner decides every item. Never claim an item is done or deployed.
3 Funds, disbursement, refund money movement, signing, wallet/Safe, credentials are never routed to a model seat as an action; they may only be judged as keep_manual or needs_owner_value.
4 No credentials, keys, mail bodies, amounts or customer data in output; de-identified labels only.
5 Unknown stays unknown; never substitute another seat's answer and never invent evidence.
6 NEGATIVE AUTHORIZATION, not a routing rule: money, signing, wallet/Safe, disbursement, production writes, credentials stay outside every model seat. Citing rule 6 to justify a route is invalid.

WORKER COVERAGE: exactly grok and claude, one bounded task each, all 19 items per seat. doubao, qianwen and kimi are excluded from this card: doubao and kimi failed twice and qianwen already answered. Do not choose any other seat.

FORMAT
- Planner deepseek: return ONLY JSON {"summary":"<=100 chars","tasks":[{"seat":"grok","task":"<=900 chars"},{"seat":"claude","task":"<=900 chars"}],"needs_gpt_decision":false,"reason":null}. Exactly two tasks, one per required seat. No prose outside the JSON.
- Worker (each of grok, claude): return ONLY 19 pipe-separated lines, one per item id in order 1..19, and then one last line starting with TOP3. No prose, no summary, no plan, no markdown, no provider/model declarations, no echo of this prompt:
  <id> | <route> | <blocker <=18 words> | <risk <=12 words> | <first step <=18 words>
  TOP3 | <ids of the three items you would automate first, comma separated> | <why <=20 words>
Every line <=120 chars.
